|translation='''Title:''' Limited Resources.

'''Card text:''' Use when the opponent has two cards or fewer in hand. The opponent immediately loses 2 Force (4 Force if it is your turn). If the opponent has 融合ジェネレータ供給タンク aboard a starship, the loss is reduced by 2.

'''Lore:''' The Empire keeps resources under military control. The Rebellion is thrifty, but supply officers still have to dump emergency stores.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 融合ジェネレータ供給タンク for Fusion Generator Supply Tanks.
